lines.en: My black wings skim the shade
I weave between the vines
My wingbeats hold a steady beat
I fly close past a trunk
I swing around a broad leaf
I fly low beneath the canopy
My wing edges carry white
I head for that clump of flowers
I slip into a gap in the leaves
I drift in the warm air
I fly straight and fast
I take half a turn about the grove
I skim a patch of ferns
I pass a tree hollow
My wings trace a curve
I fly toward a shaft of light
I rest my wings along a leaf vein
My wings open and close slowly
I wait for a gust of wind
My antennae shift
Sunlight passes through my wings
I stay still under the trees
Dew still hangs on the leaf tips
I fold my wings slowly
I feel the air move
I waver between two blooms
My shadow falls on the veins
My markings shine in the shade
You are blocking my flowers
I lift higher on the wing

lines.zh: 你的气息吹乱了我的触角
lines.en: Your breath musses my antennae
My wings are spread wide
What are you doing in the grove
I pass by your shoulder

lines.zh: 你眨眼时我的翅停了一下
lines.en: My wings pause while you blink
Do not raise your hand
I know the red of poppies
I skim past your hat brim
One of my wings is bent
I lose some height
I beat hard to steady myself
A patch of scale dust is rubbed off
I settle on a leaf to recover
My antennae draw in
My black wings beat out of rhythm
I can still get airborne
That left me dazed
I crawl slowly along the leaf
Is that a poppy
I smell nectar
Lower the flower a little
I drift down toward it
Just one sip of it
The one you hold is red
I reach out my proboscis to try
This flower is very fresh
I circle the flower once
My wings quiver as I feed
You touched my wing
I tumble once in the air
Some of my scale dust falls
I hurry upward to clear you
You have blocked my path
I bank away sharply
A little scale dust lands on you
My heartbeat quickens
I settle on a twig to steady
I reset the angle of my wings
There are other black wings here
I follow the wind to find them
We circle the same flower clump
Her wings are broader than mine
We fly one behind the other
I rise and fall with her
We rest side by side on a leaf

lines.zh: 林子里有很多这样的舞
lines.en: The grove holds many such dances
I remember her markings
We fly on together
I land on something bright
It is cooler than a petal
I test it with my feet
This is not a flower at all
I flutter my wings and lift off
I settle and leave again
I draw my feet up
I taste it, there is nothing
I go back to the flowers
I've marked this bright stone
There is a patch of red there
My antennae turn that way
I have changed my heading
I will arrive before the wind
I drop low and glide over
My wings are speeding up
I have found a nectar source
I make for that red
I swerve around a branch
These are the flowers of this treeline
I drop a little lower
That bloom sways in the wind
I trim my wings
The wind blows left, I angle off
I am an inch from the petals
I put my legs out
I approach slowly
The bloom is just past the leaves
I pick the widest open one
I wait for the wind to ease
My wings beat across your face
I bump into your finger
I beat upward and away
My wing smacks your hand
One hard beat and I am gone
I turn sharply about you
I skim past your ear
My wing edge brushes you
The bump knocks me off course
And I return to the flowers
A black flash crosses the blooms
I drift down from the canopy
My wings catch the light
I settle on a red flower
The jungle heat holds me up
I come out from the vines
A fleck of black joins the shade
I beat my wings and rise
I round a whole tree
I land on the flower before you
Flame curls the tip of my wing
I drop onto a leaf, stunned
Water glues my wings together
The blast flings me far

lines.zh: 一支箭擦掉了我的翅粉
lines.en: An arrow scrapes off my scales

lines.zh: 咒光让我翅上的纹乱了
lines.en: Magic scrambles my wing marks
The flowers are gone and I fly weak
The flash makes my wings jerk
My wings still beat as I fall
